referenceLocale.description: Source-of-truth locale used as the baseline for coverage and structure enforcement (e.g. "en_US").

enforceStructure.description: Require non-reference locales in folder mode to mirror the reference locale's folder structure exactly.

stripComments.description: Strip all comment and blank lines from the normal merged output.

randomizeEntries.description: Globally shuffle all entries in the merged output. Produces entries-only output with no comments, blanks, or section headers.

errorOnMissingTranslations.description: Fail the build if any non-reference locale is missing keys present in the reference. Coverage report is written before failing.

coverage.description: Generate a translation coverage report at ROOT_DIR/reports/rune_coverage_report.md.
